minecraft:written_book_content.title: Surveyor's Addendum
minecraft:written_book_content.author: A. Senn
pages: {"text":"The rings do not align with the compass. The frame contains nothing, but the measurements change when viewed from the other side."}
{"text":"Do not mark a route through the center."}

{"text":"A mark is repeated in every hidden lower chamber: three short strokes around an empty center. A research diagram labels this frame as a boundary, then draws the same mark on both sides. The note beneath it reads: 'There was no other side.'"}
